tagline: Weave your notes into a story you can walk through.
hero_subtitle: An AI-Based Personalized Memory Palace Generator for Adaptive Learning
disclaimer: LociLoom is a study aid, not a guaranteed memory treatment. Memory palaces are not the only effective study method. Retrieval practice and spaced repetition are also used in this app.
step1_desc: Paste your study notes or pick a syllabus topic. NLP extracts key concepts and calculates difficulty.
step2_desc: Concepts become concrete visual mnemonics placed sequentially along an interactive 2D route.
step3_desc: Practice spatial retrieval quizzes and follow SM-2 spaced repetition powered by forgetting curve predictions.
nlp_note: Note: Concept extraction currently works best for English input text.
